periods.time: vol-10 ch-003 flashback, day before Seven Stars opening

name.zh: 宁音逼出史黛菈的龙神附身
name.en: Nene forces Stella's Dragon Spirit awakening

periods.summary: During Stella's special training, Nene says Stella's sword has a decisive flaw but refuses to explain. On the day before the tournament, Nene attacks seriously, using gravity to distort space, nullify Stella's fire trajectories, and crush her with Ground Binding. As Stella nearly gives up, she realizes she has forgotten the pride proper to someone born with the world's greatest magic. She drives Laevateinn into her chest and releases a storm of light and heat, awakening Dragon Spirit. Nene smiles, satisfied that Stella has finally found her true power.
periods.cause: Nene believes Stella's humility toward lesser talents suppresses the power of an absolute strong one and would make her lose to Ouma.
periods.outcome: Stella learns that her true ability is not simple fire but manifestation of the mythic Dragon concept, enabling her later semifinal victory.
periods.significance: Explains Stella's sudden leap in power and reframes her ability as concept interference rather than ordinary fire manipulation.
